fusions.name: Spat Grit
fusions.desc: Spits venom-wet gravel that deals 9 damage. It needs one of your afflictions on the target and uses it up.

fusions.name: Adder in the Scree
fusions.desc: A strike from nowhere that deals 34 damage, up to 1.6 times that at maximum range, and leaves the target [Poisoned] for 3 damage a second for 6 seconds. Every hit is a critical hit.

fusions.name: Cast Skin
fusions.desc: Removes up to 2 poison conditions from you. Your movement speed rises 15% for 4 seconds after you use it.

fusions.name: Patient Poison
fusions.desc: Your afflictions take hold on an enemy that is immune to them. You carry 8% poison resistance for as long as you carry it.
